prose.text: The chunk's own entries come first, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order. `capability-drift` precedes the default-features workspace nextest. The `--features mcp-server` regen and the base-identity bindings close come last, since no procedure is added. The live legs and the operator pass follow.

Absences, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so the webview gates are absent. - No boot path is touched (`main.rs`, `observability.rs`, `ui-bridge`, `tauri.conf.json` and the capabilities stay   unchanged), so no boot-smoke entry is listed. The GREEN end-to-end leg boots the real binary anyway. - No Rust dependency is added, which the scope guard asserts (`Cargo.lock` / `Cargo.toml` excluded from its allow list).   The one third-party file is the vendored Python converter, which cargo-deny cannot see. Its MIT provenance is recorded   beside it (step 2) and asserted by an entry. CI's `supply-chain` job runs `cargo deny` / `cargo audit`, and the CI read   asserts it. - No headful self-verify: no UI change.

The live legs: the operator boots `target/debug/pulse-app` by path for each end-to-end leg, on a fresh `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` exported once for that leg, and stops it by pid. The boot is the operator's, so no entry starts the app. The RED-leg reads run once, on the chunk-base build, before step 2. The GREEN reads run on the rebuilt tree.

Producers of what the criteria read: - The app's log family is produced by the operator's boot, which no entry makes. - `evidence/red-leg.md`, `evidence/green-leg.md` and `evidence/mutation-checks.md` are written by /implement from the   entries' recorded outputs, with host paths placeholdered. - The step-8 mutations edit source and revert, so each is a ONE-SHOT run at implement, both readings in   `evidence/mutation-checks.md`. The non-mutating unit entries guard the same properties on every re-run. - The grader's `L4_GPU_PRIMARY_BUDGET_MS=1` mutation changes only the environment, so it is a listed entry. - The real round trip (`binary(integration_real_llama_cli)`) drives no external process a probe could check first: it   spawns `llama-cli` itself. Its precondition is the operator slot entry before it, ports free and no `llama-cli`   resident, so no `round` probe precedes it.
